input.summary: Limit Section 4.9(a) inspections to once per Calendar Year on 30 days' written notice, at Array's expense.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 4.9(a) currently allows unlimited inspections of our facilities on merely "reasonable" notice and at our cost, so we have added our standard limits of one inspection per Calendar Year, thirty days' prior written notice and Array bearing its own inspection costs (with a carve-out for for-cause follow-up inspections). We can accept fifteen days' notice as a fallback.

ops.oldText: during normal business hours and upon reasonable advance notice to inspect
ops.newText: during normal business hours, no more than once per Calendar Year (other than a follow-up inspection reasonably required to verify remediation of a non-compliance previously identified), upon at least thirty (30) days' prior written notice and at Array's expense, to inspect
